_notes: Made by tools/run_tests.py --map: for each topic, the files a change to which can affect its tests (the source files they ran, measured with coverage; the types they name; the enums and constants that code uses; the test files and recordings they use). --changed reads it. "files" is each mapped file's fingerprint when it was made: a file changed since then counts as changed too, so an old map runs more topics, never too few.
